mediaLibrary.title: Upload library
mediaLibrary.intro: Scans known upload folders under public (nature video/audio/thumbs, music audio/backgrounds, analysis JSON). Preview files, select, and delete leftovers from experiments. If a URL still appears in data/nature-settings.json or data/music-companion.json, delete is blocked unless you check “Force delete” (only when you are sure nothing uses it).
mediaLibrary.deletePartial: Some files were not removed; see the error message above.
mediaLibrary.empty: No files match the current filters.

naturePage.title: Nature
naturePage.intro: Two blocks: Ambient is a separate shared library—upload a few loops (water, birds, etc.) that every clip can use. Background video is where each clip builds its own mix from that library. The home page (full-screen nature) plays the current clip’s picture and sound.
naturePage.galleryHint: Tap a card to set the clip for the home page (saved immediately).
naturePage.galleryThumbHint: Capture a center crop from this clip for the gallery and the home-page poster.
naturePage.ambientBlockIntro: Separate from video: only reusable sound sources live here. Upload a handful; every background clip below draws from the same pool for its own mix. Deleting a source removes it from every mix that references it.
naturePage.ambientUploadFoot: Supports mp3 / wav / ogg / m4a / aac / opus / webm / flac, up to ~80 MB per file; same disk-write rules as video uploads.
naturePage.ambientBadType: Please pick a common audio format (e.g. mp3, wav, m4a).
naturePage.ambientListEmpty: No sources yet. Upload files to use them in mixes below.
naturePage.videoBlockIntro: Upload looping video to public/nature/uploads. Each clip lists every Ambient source at 0% by default—raise only the tracks you want in the mix. The home page plays the current clip’s video and mix.
naturePage.mixSectionTitle: Mix for this clip (only this clip)
naturePage.mixPreviewHint: Video fills the preview (cropped, no side bars), muted loop. Every library source is listed below at 0% by default—raise only what you need. Drag while previewing to hear live; release to save.
naturePage.mixAllClipsEmpty: No ambient sources yet. Upload in the Ambient block above first.
naturePage.thumbModalHint: From a video frame or an image file. Pick a moment or file, adjust the square crop, then save.
naturePage.thumbModalImageHint: JPG, PNG, or WebP. Use the crop slider when the photo is wider or taller than a square.
naturePage.thumbModalPanHint: Wide clips: move the square crop horizontally.
naturePage.thumbModalPanHintVertical: Tall clips: move the square crop vertically.
naturePage.thumbModalPanNoSlack: This frame is nearly square—there is almost no room to pan.
naturePage.thumbModalVideoError: Could not load this video. Check the file or try again.
naturePage.thumbModalCaptureFail: Could not export this frame. Wait until the video has decoded.
